title: Lid-driven square cavity, Re = 100 (Ghia, Ghia & Shin 1982)
description:
Steady laminar flow of an incompressible Newtonian fluid in a lid-driven square cavity (2D).
Geometry (STEP, planar face in the xy-plane): square 0 <= x <= 1.0, 0 <= y <= 1.0 m. Model it as 2D (out-of-plane thickness 1 m).
Fluid: density rho = 1.0 kg/m^3, dynamic viscosity mu = 0.01 Pa s.
Boundary conditions:
  lid y = 1.0: wall moving tangentially with velocity (u_x, u_y) = (1.0, 0) m/s (no slip relative to the lid)
  bottom y = 0 and side walls x = 0, x = 1.0: stationary no-slip walls
The cavity is closed (no inlet or outlet), so only velocities are reported.
Report (SI units), velocities at points on the two centrelines:
  u_vcl_min  u_x (horizontal velocity) at (0.5, 0.453125) [m/s]
  v_hcl_max  u_y (vertical velocity) at (0.234375, 0.5) [m/s]
  v_hcl_min  u_y (vertical velocity) at (0.8046875, 0.5) [m/s]
  u_centre   u_x (horizontal velocity) at (0.5, 0.5) [m/s]
